findings.title: Legacy flexbox fallback no longer right-aligns the panel
findings.body: The new `flexbox()` mixin falls back to the legacy `-webkit-box`/`-moz-box` layout in older browsers, but `margin-left: auto` does not push an item to the far edge in that legacy box model. Since the previous `float: right` was removed, the header panel will sit beside the title instead of at the right edge in browsers that use this fallback. Add a legacy-compatible spacing rule or avoid selecting the legacy box layout without one.

findings.title: The legacy Mozilla box fallback cannot apply item alignment
findings.body: `flexbox()` and `inline-flex()` emit `-moz-box` and `-moz-inline-box` fallbacks, but `align-items()` does not emit the corresponding `-moz-box-align` property. In older Firefox versions that use those display fallbacks, the new header centering and badge baseline alignment are ignored, so those layouts differ from browsers using modern flexbox. Add the Mozilla legacy alignment declaration if these fallbacks are intended to work.
